name: WMUISignaturePad
description: Freehand signature capture. The user draws with a finger or pointer; each stroke hands back a base64 PNG the page can upload. On iOS and Android this draws through a WebView canvas; web has no WebView, so it ships a separate pointer-and-vector implementation that returns the same base64 PNG. Stroke width varies with speed on device and is fixed on web.

penColor.name: penColor
penColor.description: Stroke color of the drawn signature. Default: #1D1B20

backgroundColor.name: backgroundColor
backgroundColor.description: Background color of the signature canvas, and of the exported PNG. Default: #FFFFFF

minWidth.name: minWidth
minWidth.description: Thinnest stroke width, used at speed. On web the min and max are averaged into one fixed width. Default: 2

maxWidth.name: maxWidth
maxWidth.description: Thickest stroke width, used when the pointer moves slowly. Default: 4

onSignatureEnd.name: onSignatureEnd
onSignatureEnd.description: Fires each time the user lifts their finger after a stroke, with the signature as a base64 PNG data URI and the running stroke count.

onClear.name: onClear
onClear.description: Fires after the signature canvas is cleared.
